display_long_description:
EV Technician is an advanced VR training app designed to provide hands-on experience in electric vehicle technology. Part of our ImmerseLearn  Electric Vehicle (EV) Technician Program, it includes interactive modules covering: 

-EV powertrains, battery technologies, and charging infrastructure
-Vehicle diagnostics and troubleshooting high-voltage systems
-Electric motor systems, energy storage, and power electronics
-Battery pack assembly, testing, and thermal management
-High-voltage safety procedures and compliance with global standards
-Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and autonomous -vehicle technologies
-Software control systems in modern EVs
-EV maintenance and system optimization
-Environmental sustainability in electric vehicle technology

As part of the ImmerseLearn EV Technician program, this engaging virtual environment provides realistic training in EV maintenance, troubleshooting, and technology. Learners get to engage and interact in immersive virtual environments and develop skills that prepare them to take on real-world tasks with confidence. With hands-on training, this is not just learning but an opportunity to gain experience in a safe and controlled environment. 

Whether you're an aspiring technician or a professional looking to enhance your expertise, this EV Technician program equips you with the knowledge and practical experience needed for the growing EV industry. 

Start training today!
